runtime: ONNX Runtime Web single-thread WASM + JavaScript baseline

subword_character_metrics.confidence_interval_method: 1000 bootstrap resamples of documents, fixed seed; descriptive for this benchmark, not a deployment guarantee.
subword_character_metrics.empty_gold_caveat: No annotated span does not establish that a comment is benign. Some entire comments are toxic without attributable spans.

held_out_worker_processing.scope: Actual held-out comments with variable lengths, no warmup, separate from fixed-size warm latency benchmark.

linear-balanced.note: Browser inference batches overlapping chunks within a document. Native evaluation batches chunks across documents. Dynamic quantization can produce small differences. Display merges contiguous subwords using maximum score; its accuracy is reported separately.
